race.description: Munday Construction & Civil Super Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: READY MADE HEIR (9) holding her form on the provincial circuit and has the class to overcome the awkward gate and put these away. Three weeks between runs second up with a plugging sixth over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Senior rider hops aboard and expected to go close. FRATIANNO (1) tough gelding unlucky not to have the Maiden win out of the way. Closed strongly with the 59kg when a narrow third over 1004m at this track. Placed at the trip and no shock to see him take this out. OPINE (3) resumes from a sticky draw. Best performance in her four career starts when second over 1000m at Coffs Harbour in a Super Maiden on August 7. Finished third in her only trial and worth thought. PLUME (7) gripped on late first up when second at Newcastle, then struck trouble at the start and failed to close off when seventh over 1200m at Gosford. Lugging bit goes on and place preferred.
